column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline — triaged rules for https://aicctv.dev (weekly Security workflow).
# Format: <plugin id><TAB><IGNORE|WARN|FAIL><TAB>(<why>). Anything not listed keeps ZAP's default (WARN).
# IGNORE is used ONLY for alerts that were checked by hand and are informational or false positives;
# real hardening gaps stay visible. Reviewed 2026-09-20 against ZAP report #19.
# Still reported on purpose (accepted, keep watching):
#   10055 CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline' — React inline style attributes + runtime <style> injection cannot carry a nonce; scripts stay nonce-bound (lib/csp.ts).
#   90004 Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy — not set: require-corp would block signed Supabase Storage media. COOP + CORP are set (next.config.ts).
#   10010 Cookie without HttpOnly — mongolz-lang / mongolz-theme are UI preferences read by client code.
#   10021/10063 on /<hash>/script.js — Vercel Speed Insights asset served by the platform CDN, outside the app's header config.
#   10035 HSTS on /logo.png and /sw.js — the 200 responses carry HSTS; ZAP sees Vercel's bare `304 Not Modified` for static files, which has no headers at all
#     (verified with If-None-Match). Browsers keep the cached 200's headers and .dev is HSTS-preloaded. Left visible so a real HSTS regression on a page still shows.

column3: (Anti-CSRF tokens: forms are Next.js Server Actions — POST-only, Origin/Host checked by the framework, SameSite cookies; no token field by design)
(Cross-domain misconfiguration: Access-Control-Allow-Origin * is added by the Vercel CDN to public static assets only; no credentialed or API response carries it)
(User-controllable attribute: /login?next= is passed through sanitizeNextPath() and rendered React-escaped into a hidden input)
(Sensitive info in URL: /monitoring?o=&p= are the public Sentry org/project ids of the tunnel route, not secrets)
(Private IP disclosure: 192.168.x.x strings are input placeholders for LAN camera URLs in the bundle)
(Suspicious comments: explanatory comments in the public service worker)
(Base64 disclosure: hashed asset names, nonces and inlined fonts)
(Storable / cacheable content: informational; authenticated pages are not reachable by the baseline spider)
(Re-examine cache-control: public probe, manifest, offline page and robots.txt carry nothing private)
(Sec-Fetch-* headers: these are REQUEST headers the scanner itself does not send)
